name: Best of the Best
caption: A brother tag team who upset the INWI Hall of Famers Solid Gold on the promotion's own closing weekend.

tenures.source: the promotion's own closing pay-per-view weekend (19-21 March 1999)
tenures.note: Upset Hall of Famers Solid Gold in 14:21 on the second night of the closing weekend (20 March 1999); competed in the promotion's own final four-way tag elimination for the World Tag Team Championship the following night, won by Dark Justice.

name: Pass Line Posse
caption: A tag team entered in the INWI's own final four-way tag team title match.

tenures.source: the promotion's own closing pay-per-view weekend (19-21 March 1999)
tenures.note: Competed in the promotion's own final four-way tag elimination for the World Tag Team Championship on its last night, 21 March 1999, won by Dark Justice.

name: Dark Justice
caption: Held the INWI World Tag Team Championship into the promotion's own close, retaining it in a four-way elimination on the last night.

tenures.source: the promotion's own closing pay-per-view weekend, 21 March 1999
tenures.note: Retained the World Tag Team Championship in a four-way elimination against Solid Gold, Best of the Best and the Pass Line Posse on the promotion's own last night, 21 March 1999, closing the record as the final champions; neither member is named in the surviving text.

identity.note: Name collision only: a same-named entity in another wing (dark-justice-npwa); no shared operator, chronology or storyline evidence in this wing's documents.
